simplify_kernel_name: simplify long CUDA kernel names like void permute_pooled_embs_kernel to shorter readable labels
convert_figure_name_to_title: convert a snake_case figure name like my_figure_name to a human readable title like My Figure Name
prepare_timeline_events: prepare a trace DataFrame with timeline events including task labels, start times, end times, and colors for plotting
align_cpu_gpu_kernels: align CPU module events with GPU kernel events in a trace DataFrame to show CPU-GPU correspondence
plot_timeline_events: plot prepared timeline events as an interactive Gantt chart using plotly and save to an HTML file
